verdict.rationale: Milvus Lite lets users spin up a local, file-based Milvus instance (e.g. `MilvusClient("milvus_demo.db")`) with the same client API as Standalone/Distributed production deployments, enabling prototyping and testing entirely separate from production data (milvus-docs-1, milvus-docs-8, milvus-docs-17, milvus-docs-19, milvus-gh-1). This is explicitly positioned for quick prototyping in Jupyter notebooks/edge devices before scaling to production. Missing for 10: no explicit 'sandbox' terminology or guidance on safely testing against a shared non-prod environment (e.g. staging cluster), and no independent/community confirmation of this specific workflow.
